Additional evidence from the same hotclm pass (objectstack-ai/hotclm#87, 17.7.0, 1440×900) · 2026-10-10T02:37Z — the dialog is not only narrow, it does not scroll:

- Intake flow screen 2: dialog `height 1184px, top -142px, bottom 1042px, overflow-y: visible`; the Submit button sits at y=977 and ten `mouse.wheel` ticks move nothing; the heading is clipped off the top (screenshots `016`, `018`). A mouse user cannot reach Submit; keyboard focus + Enter can.
- The same layout hosts **action parameter dialogs**: "Backfill Executed Contract" (a `params` list) measures `height 2198px, top -649px` — its first five required fields sit above the top edge (`111`, `112`).
- `ScreenConfigSchema` (strict) carries no layout / columns / width key, so metadata cannot ask for a different size; object create/edit forms, by contrast, render two columns and scroll (`050`, `081`).

Repro: any flow `screen` node or action `params` list longer than ~12 fields on a 900px-high viewport. Screenshots are under `qa/browser-test-17-7/screenshots/` on branch `claude/issue-87-browser-test-17-7` of objectstack-ai/hotclm.
